notes: Direct fetch (probe.fetch) worked throughout, no blocking - same as the prior Home-Decor pass. Tree taken from the site's own rendered mega-nav in the page header (parsed a.header-nav__link out of the /furniture HTML): the Furniture department is a FLAT list of 12 nav items with no deeper nav level, so no grouping rows were needed. qty for every row is the rendered listing header N items; on every page this agreed exactly with the rendered filter-drawer button 'View N products' and with the embedded listing JSON totalResults/endRow, three independent reads. Counts vary per category (5..55) so they are not a site-wide constant, none are suspiciously round, and a second live fetch of 6 pages returned identical numbers (no intra-session drift). Did NOT count product hrefs - the listing pages inject recommendation carousels (e.g. /furniture/vintage-furniture shows 21 product links for a 16-item category). Bedside Tables and Chest of Drawers & Wardrobes are the site's OWN nav items and the site itself points them at product_type-filtered URLs on the shared /furniture/bedside-tables-and-chest-of-drawers page (parent 44 = Bedside Tables 26 + Dressers 14 + Wardrobes 3 + 1 cross-listed Bed); the two children were recorded rather than the parent-as-leaf per the deepest-node rule. Outdoor: /outdoor totals 56 and outdoor-seating 18 + outdoor-tables 21 + sunloungers 5 + parasols 7 + fire pits 5 = 56 exactly, which partitions the department; /coffee-and-side-tables (7) was verified as a STRICT SUBSET of /outdoor/outdoor-tables (all 7 product handles contained in its 21) and was dropped as a re-cut. Excluded: /storage-and-decor (11 - opened it, tiles are an umbrella stand, recycling bin, catchalls, a bowl, ashtrays and magazine racks: storage/decor accessories, not furniture); /outdoor/outdoor-accessories (7, parasols and shades); /outdoor/fire-pits-and-accessories (5); /bathroom/bathroom-mirrors and /home-accessories/mirrors, /mirrors, /home-accessories/floor-mirrors (mirrors); /bathroom/accessories-and-hardware (bathroom hardware); all Lighting, Rugs & Textiles, Tabletop/Dining, Home Fragrance, Art, Vases, Vintage Decor, Books & Vinyls, Gifting; every */sale node and /new/* node; /inspiration/shop-the-look/* room pages and buying guides (landing pages). /bathroom/vanities was INCLUDED as Bathroom Furniture - opened it, the 17 tiles are single/double vanity UNITS (cabinetry), not sinks or taps. /furniture/vintage-furniture kept - tiles are genuine vintage chairs, side tables, coffee tables, benches, drinks cabinets and shelving. /furniture/entryway-consoles-and-shelving kept - its Shelving facet (7) is freestanding furniture shelving (Elwood Shelving, Marin Shelving Unit), not wall shelves. Sum of the 13 Furniture leaves is 409 against the /furniture department total of 413; the 4-item gap is cross-listing and no total was ever derived by summing.
